Theme

Latin word

antehāc

adverb

before now, until now

In this lexicon

  • previously

    also used · classical · Gell. 16.3.2: cum antehāc semper edundī fuerit adpetēns, nunc …; Traupman 88: previously, antehāc, prius

Examples

  • cum antehāc semper edundī fuerit adpetēns, nunc post imperātam inediam triduī omnis ejus adpetītiō prīstina ēlanguerit

    though he had always been fond of his food before, now, after the three days’ fast he was ordered, all his old appetite has died awayGell. 16.3.2

    In the entry for previously

  • ō suāvis anima! quāle tē dīcam bonum antehāc fuisse, tālēs cum sint reliquiae?

    O sweet soul! How good must I say you were before, when your leavings are like this?Phaedr. 3.1.5–6

    In the entry for previously
